reason: E1 shows a single-phase HEA with homogeneous element distribution exhibits type-II superconductivity and intermediate electron–phonon coupling, but it does not compare high- vs. low-entropy states or establish that entropy causes the uniformity or enhances coupling. Neither passage supports the causal claims that high entropy ensures uniformity, that uniformity enhances coupling, or that reducing entropy weakens superconductivity.
